about: A send the server refuses while the next message is being typed, then a reload. The refusal is a stand-in: for the capture the page's fetch is wrapped so that POST .../messages answers 400 'The server could not take this message' after 2.5 seconds; the reload removes the wrap, so the Retry is a real send. Before is the base of the pull request, after is its branch.

type.name: Message Pepper
type.text: Book the 9am train to Leeds on Thursday

steps.eval: (() => { const real = window.fetch; window.fetch = (input, init) => { const url = new URL(typeof input === 'string' ? input : input.url, location.href); if ((init?.method ?? 'GET') === 'POST' && url.pathname.endsWith('/messages')) return new Promise((done) => setTimeout(() => done(new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: 'The server could not take this message' }), { status: 400, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } })), 2500)); return real(input, init); }; return true; })()
